answer: XS-2031 currently carries a 4.25% annual coupon and can step up to 6.00% from the start of year 3 if the issuer's rating from any named agency falls below BBB-. The step-up applies once and does not reverse if the rating later recovers.
caveats: The step-up is triggered only if the issuer rating falls below BBB- (from any agency named in the offering terms) and takes effect from the start of coupon year 3.
